name: Stamina Body Fitness Club
address: Jawahara silver building - 1st floor - above life pharmacy - Hay Al Nahda - Sharjah - United Arab Emirates
owner_description:
Your premier destination for health and fitness in Al Nahda, Sharjah! Whether you're looking to build strength, improve stamina, or just stay active, we have everything you need. Our state-of-the-art gym is equipped with the latest cardio and strength-training equipment, a dedicated area for functional training, and a wide range of group fitness classes, including yoga, spinning, and Zumba.

With certified personal trainers, personalized workout plans, and a motivating community, we are committed to helping you reach your fitness goals. Conveniently located in Al Nahda, Sharjah, Stamina Body Fitness Club offers flexible membership options and special promotions for new members. Experience fitness like never before—where results meet fun!

reviews.author: Puneeth Shetty
reviews.text:
I had a really great experience at this gym. The entire place is very well maintained, and all the equipment is in excellent condition. The environment is clean, hygienic, and highly disciplined, which makes it very comfortable and motivating to work out here.
One thing I truly appreciate is how supportive the trainers are. In many gyms, personal attention comes only if you pay for a personal trainer. But here, even without opting for personal training, the trainers actively guide you. They check whether you’re doing the exercises correctly and are always willing to help whenever you ask. They explain everything patiently and politely, which is really encouraging, especially for beginners.
A special mention to Mr. *Aashiq*    he is extremely disciplined, professional, and dedicated. His training style is clear, motivating, and very supportive. He ensures that everyone maintains proper form and stays consistent. His positive attitude really makes a difference.
Overall, this gym stands out for its cleanliness, discipline, and genuinely helpful trainers. Highly recommended.

reviews.text:
Overall, I’m very happy with the gym. It’s always clean, well maintained, and has a great atmosphere that makes working out enjoyable. The equipment is modern and in excellent condition, and the staff are friendly and very helpful.

My only suggestion would be to consider adding some of the newer generation strength machines. These machines are designed to isolate specific muscle groups more effectively and make training more efficient, reducing the need to move between multiple machines or perform several different exercises to target the same muscle.

I believe adding a few of these newer machines would further improve the training experience and make an already excellent gym even better.

Thank you for providing such a great facility.
